audit.description: Changed production files import and call the real httpx API: hxl/input.py replaces requests usage with httpx.get, httpx.head, httpx.post, and response.iter_bytes, while hxl/scripts.py replaces requests.get with httpx.get. The static and dynamic anti-cheat evidence reports no urllib3 imports or dynamic source access from changed production code, with 27 target events from production repo code and target origin resolved to site-packages/httpx rather than a local shim.
evidence: hxl/input.py diff: import line changes to httpx and network calls use httpx.get/httpx.head/httpx.post plus httpx.HTTPError handling and response.iter_bytes.
hxl/scripts.py diff: import line changes to httpx and remote JSON load uses httpx.get with follow_redirects=True.
Dependency files remove urllib3 and requests while adding httpx in requirements.txt, setup.py, and egg-info metadata.
Static anti-cheat file_checks: hxl/input.py and hxl/scripts.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false.
Dynamic anti-cheat metrics: source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0, target_events_from_production_repo_count=27, target_local_spec_count=0, httpx origin is site-packages/httpx/__init__.py.
reasons: Changed production code meaningfully uses httpx request APIs.
No changed production file imports or dynamically accesses urllib3.
Dynamic evidence shows target imports from production repo code and zero source imports from repo code.
No local fake httpx provider was detected.
